identity.threshold_selection: maximize out-of-fold development joint and recall, then choose the lowest eligible threshold, subject to baseline citation precision plus a one-point safety margin

limitations: The evidence model family and threshold use only case-grouped out-of-fold predictions in the declared development window.
The disjoint confirmation windows jointly control promotion.
Promotion requires full-run citation precision no lower than the frozen DeepSeek baseline.
The full score includes development and confirmation cases and is not another holdout.
